title: ConstantModulePushforwardFunctoriality
statement: For every commutative ring Lambda in universe u+1 and every Lambda-module M, the map from f1_* M_Y1 to f2_* M_Y2 associated to g:Y2 -> Y1 over X is defined by the inverse-image unit, the canonical constant-sheaf comparison [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant], and direct-image composition [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. This map preserves identity and composition contravariantly in g. No finiteness assumptions are imposed.

proof.text: For g:Y2 -> Y1 over X, take the inverse-image unit at the constant M-sheaf, followed by g_* of the canonical comparison g^* M_Y1 -> M_Y2. Push this map forward by f1 and compose with the canonical g_* f1_* composition comparison. This is exactly constantModulePushforwardMap.

source.place: Tag 09Z1, degree-zero transition maps and continuity; Tag 09Z6, finite approximation paragraph, lines 12999-13008

proof.text: Under the constant-sheaf/global-sections adjunction, the canonical pullback comparison preserves the section with each value m. On etale U over X the resulting map is restriction along U times_X Y2 -> U times_X Y1. Restrictions along an identity are identities, and along a composite are the composites in reverse order. This holds on the constant presheaves and extends uniquely to their sheafifications. The pushforward comparison is the fibre-product pasting map, so the identity and composition equalities are the asserted ones. Equivalently, take mates under the inverse-image adjunction and use its unit and composition coherence; the uniqueness of the constant-sheaf comparison gives the same mates.

theorem constantModulePushforwardMap_id_comp
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) :
    (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X),
      constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M f f (𝟙 Y) (Category.id_comp f) = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (∀ {X Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ : Y₁ ⟶ X) (f₂ : Y₂ ⟶ X) (f₃ : Y₃ ⟶ X)
      (g : Y₂ ⟶ Y₁) (g' : Y₃ ⟶ Y₂) (h : g ≫ f₁ = f₂) (h' : g' ≫ f₂ = f₃),
      constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M f₁ f₃ (g' ≫ g)
          (by rw [Category.assoc, h, h']) =
        constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M f₁ f₂ g h ≫
          constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M f₂ f₃ g' h')
